origin.note: The commit the origin https://getunstuck.space is expected to serve. Refreshed by the deployer (deploy_pin in /root/work/unstuck-deploy.py) at the start of every deploy, from whatever the origin is serving at that moment, then committed — a repo cannot contain the sha of the commit that writes it, so the pin names the PREVIOUS deployment and the next deploy moves it. It also names recorded_by (the HEAD the depth was measured against) and depth_from_head, the ordered coordinate git rev-list --count <expected_commit>..<recorded_by>. Read by tests/site_deployed_pin.test.mjs: L61 the pin is a real ancestor with a true depth; L62 the origin is serving exactly the pinned commit; L63 the pin is committed at HEAD. Staleness after a commit is a valid state until the next deploy — not a passing one, since L62 fails until the origin catches up.
